name: Power & Revolution
description: Power & Revolution (Geopolitical Simulator 4) is a comprehensive geopolitical simulation where players act as head of state or opposition leader in any of 175 countries. The engine tracks over 600 real-time data elements across economic, military, political, social, and environmental domains.
reputation: Recognized benchmark for realistic, data-driven geopolitical simulation games.
notes: Ultra-detailed real-time world simulation with extensive modding support.
